Question_text: The diagrams show the demand curves for the only two buyers in a market. What will be the shape of the market demand curve for the good?
image: Two individual demand curves are shown at the top. The first is a simple linear downward-sloping curve. The second is a downward-sloping curve with a kink, being steeper at higher prices and flatter at lower prices. Below these, four options (A, B, C, D) display different shapes for a market demand curve. Option B shows a curve that is a horizontal summation of the two individual demand curves, resulting in a piecewise linear curve that becomes flatter at lower prices.
